Great pub and great beers
Aug 2026 • Couples

Ordered a beer flight, which was great, as they had a great range of beers. Each one was excellent. Would definitely recommend a visit for some great beers, in a great location for taking in the local atmosphere.

Fantastic!!
May 2024 • Couples
So glad we discovered this during our stay in Hu Chi Minh! Everything was great!! The delicious beer, especially Passion Fruit Weat Ale and Irish Stout! The food: never had such a delicious beef burger! Cheese stuffed beef rolls....yummy!! And the chicken skewers with satay sauce, fantastically tender. We ended the day here on three evenings with a beer. The staff knows what they are doing, great! The music was not always our choice, but we were happy to accept it. The toilet was clean and smelled nice. All in all great, a nice looking ambiance with the copper work!
